Northwestern University researchers demonstrated that quantum information can be transmitted over existing telecommunications fiber optic infrastructure for distances up to 15 miles while maintaining 94% fidelity. This breakthrough shows the feasibility of integrating quantum internet capabilities into current telecom networks without requiring entirely new dedicated infrastructure. The achievement represents significant progress toward practical, scalable quantum internet deployment.
